culprit_citations.quoted_text: 190 Octane Financing, LLC - Term Loan: Fair Value 7,275; Percentage of Net Assets 1.3%

rationale: The raw schedule explicitly labels the column Percentage of Net Assets and reports net assets of $551.755 million. The cited 190 Octane row is internally correct because $7.275 million divided by $551.755 million is 1.318%, which rounds to the filed 1.3%. The schedule also reports total investments of $624.289 million as 113.3% of net assets, confirming that $624.289 million is the numerator total, not the percentage denominator. The flag's fund-quarter fair-value anchor therefore applies the wrong denominator; the extracted row value is not defective.
